name: claude-bumper-lanes
description: Enforces git diff thresholds to promote disciplined code review during AI agent sessions

threshold.title: Review budget (points)
threshold.description: Points (roughly changed lines) Claude can accumulate before being blocked for review. 0 disables, 50-2000 active. Default: 600

reset_on.title: Budget reset on commit
reset_on.description: When Claude's own git commit restores the budget: 'commit' (default), 'verified-commit' (refuses --no-verify), or 'human' (only /bumper-reset restores)

on_trip.title: Trip behavior
on_trip.description: What happens at the budget limit: 'block' (default - wait for your review) or 'review' (the agent reviews its own increment, clears the breaker, and implements the findings)

max_auto_reviews.title: Self-reviews per cycle
max_auto_reviews.description: With trip behavior 'review': self-review clears allowed before a trip requires you. Default 1; -1 = unlimited (hands-off); 0 = never

review_command.title: Review command
review_command.description: The review workflow the agent is told to run when self-review is enabled. Default: /code-review

tripwires_block_auto_review.title: Tripwires require human review
tripwires_block_auto_review.description: Increments touching high-risk files (CI, dependencies, test skips) always come to you even with self-review enabled. Default: false

statusline_auto_setup.title: Add budget gauge to status line
statusline_auto_setup.description: Let the plugin add its budget gauge to your status line (edits ~/.claude/settings.json on session start). Default: false
